## Validation and files

The search retrieved **23 of 23** screened development records (100% relative recall against that set). These records were found during the build, so that result is not independent validation and does not estimate sensitivity. The optional trajectory/course block was left out: it would reduce results by 74.9%, but loses known eligible PMID 18629750. Its loss sample found 0 relevant records among 30.

The final count exceeds the standard 10,000-record screening budget. That workload was accepted because the tested optional block lost a known eligible study. The scope assumptions—including that both diagnosed PTSD and subthreshold post-traumatic stress symptoms are eligible—were not confirmed with you.
